name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Browse terminals, agents and workspace activity.
description: Publishes the live sidebar, resource status, workspace groups and filtering controls. It can show a resource in a tab or explicitly kill a terminal program. Turn it off to lose live sidebar content and its controls; saved layouts and backend-owned programs remain.

needs.why: Show opens a terminal or agent in a tab

works_with.without: Terminals are listed without workspace and worktree groups
No Agent settings action on agent rows
Close ended items only hides them
